notes: Resolved by classifying packed bounded views as nonallocating words in region planning.

reproducer.text: Run the full Atlas model render plan with repeated bounded byte view chunks at language revision f527b49. The region planner misclassifies the packed descriptor as a view allocation, skips reclamation, and the 32 MiB arena eventually traps out of bounds.

requiredBehavior: The backend must distinguish allocating cell-backed views from packed bounded view descriptors. Packed bounded views must remain valid across region resets, and loop-region reclamation must remain enabled when no allocating value crosses the region boundary.
summary: The Atlas stateful model retained packed bounded view descriptors across bounded iterations, but the backend classified those values as heap-backed views and disabled safe region reclamation. Repeated model chunks then exhausted the arena and caused an out-of-bounds failure.
title: Packed bounded views must survive safe region reclamation
